title: Our work is never over
notes:
To share is human nature,
but Free Time isn’t Free
To share takes time,
And time is money

We story tell so well,
consumption addiction
But obsession mostly harms
when victims lack action

Experiences cross space,
all this expended time
Create key lessons in,
life on&offline

Globe shows where, Gallery points the view
Users focus on living, and New Heat follows you

vis.gl triggers every sense except for odor
This shit fires me up, our work is never over.
